From 94ac8f2074b22465f75e93ecbb98060d7960f4b6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Mon, 8 Oct 2018 13:08:48 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] doc: printk-formats: Remove bogus kobject references for
 device nodes

When converting from text to rst, the kobjects section and its sole
subsection about device tree nodes were coalesced into a single section,
yielding an inconsistent result.

Remove all references to kobjects, as
  1. Device tree object pointers are not compatible to kobject pointers
     (the former may embed the latter, though), and
  2. there are no printk formats defined for kobject types.

Update the vsprintf() source code comments to match the above.

Fixes: b3ed23213eab1e08 ("doc: convert printk-formats.txt to rst")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>

diff --git a/lib/vsprintf.c b/lib/vsprintf.c
index d5b3a3f95c01..c8005105e2d6 100644
--- a/lib/vsprintf.c
+++ b/lib/vsprintf.c
@@ -1833,17 +1833,15 @@ static char *ptr_to_id(char *buf, char *end, void *ptr, struct printf_spec spec)
  *       p page flags (see struct page) given as pointer to unsigned long
  *       g gfp flags (GFP_* and __GFP_*) given as pointer to gfp_t
  *       v vma flags (VM_*) given as pointer to unsigned long
- * - 'O' For a kobject based struct. Must be one of the following:
- *       - 'OF[fnpPcCF]'  For a device tree object
- *                        Without any optional arguments prints the full_name
- *                        f device node full_name
- *                        n device node name
- *                        p device node phandle
- *                        P device node path spec (name + @unit)
- *                        F device node flags
- *                        c major compatible string
- *                        C full compatible string
- *
+ * - 'OF[fnpPcCF]'  For a device tree object
+ *                  Without any optional arguments prints the full_name
+ *                  f device node full_name
+ *                  n device node name
+ *                  p device node phandle
+ *                  P device node path spec (name + @unit)
+ *                  F device node flags
+ *                  c major compatible string
+ *                  C full compatible string
  * - 'x' For printing the address. Equivalent to "%lx".
  *
  * ** When making changes please also update:
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/Documentation/core-api/printk-formats.rst b/Documentation/core-api/printk-formats.rst
index 25dc591cb110..86023c33906f 100644
--- a/Documentation/core-api/printk-formats.rst
+++ b/Documentation/core-api/printk-formats.rst
@@ -376,15 +376,15 @@ correctness of the format string and va_list arguments.
 
 Passed by reference.
 
-kobjects
---------
+Device tree nodes
+-----------------
 
 ::
 
 	%pOF[fnpPcCF]
 
 
-For printing kobject based structs (device nodes). Default behaviour is
+For printing device tree node structures. Default behaviour is
 equivalent to %pOFf.
 
 	- f - device node full_name

### Modifications Summary

#### Modifications in Each File

1. **lib/vsprintf.c**
   - Removed references to kobjects in the comments related to the format specifier for device tree objects.
   - Updated the comment to clarify that the format specifier is specifically for device tree objects, not kobjects.

2. **Documentation/core-api/printk-formats.rst**
   - Changed the section title from "kobjects" to "Device tree nodes".
   - Updated the description to specify that the format is for printing device tree node structures, removing any mention of kobject-based structs.

#### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in both files are related as they both address the same issue: the incorrect association of kobjects with device tree nodes. The changes in `lib/vsprintf.c` clarify the source code comments to align with the documentation updates in `printk-formats.rst`. Together, these modifications ensure consistency and accuracy in the documentation and code comments regarding the handling of device tree nodes, eliminating any confusion regarding their relationship with kobjects.

When converting from text to rst, the kobjects section and its sole
subsection about device tree nodes were coalesced into a single section,
yielding an inconsistent result.

Remove all references to kobjects, as
  1. Device tree object pointers are not compatible to kobject pointers
     (the former may embed the latter, though), and
  2. there are no printk formats defined for kobject types.

Update the vsprintf() source code comments to match the above.
